command:
set -eu; echo '=== HASHES ==='; sha256sum buehne.html buehne_daemon.py; echo '=== HTTP ==='; curl -fsS -o /dev/null -w 'http_code=%{http_code}
' http://127.0.0.1:8788/; echo '=== SERVICE ==='; systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-buehne.service; systemctl --user show frankenstein-buehne.service -p MainPID -p ActiveEnterTimestamp --no-pager; echo '=== AVATAR SYMBOLS ==='; grep -nE 'kopfRollDatei|kopfRollAusgleichDeg|augen-blink|AvatarPoseState|requestAnimationFrame|kopf_rgba_parallax|parallax|LongTask|PerformanceObserver' buehne.html | head -n 240 || true; echo '=== PARALLAX INVENTORY ==='; if [ -d kopf_rgba_parallax ]; then find kopf_rgba_parallax -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%TY-%Tm-%TdT%TH:%TM:%TS %s %p
' | sort; echo '--- hashes ---'; find kopf_rgba_parallax -maxdepth 2 -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum; echo '--- metadata names ---'; find kopf_rgba_parallax -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -iname '*.json' -o -iname '*.txt' -o -iname '*.md' -o -iname '*.yaml' -o -iname '*.yml' \) -print; else echo 'NO_PARALLAX_DIR'; fi; echo '=== PROBE FILES ==='; find . -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -iname '*probe*' -o -iname '*perf*' -o -iname '*gate*' -o -iname '*mess*' \) -printf '%p
' | sort | head -n 200; echo '=== EXISTING CHROME ==='; xdotool search --name 'FranKenstein -- live' getwindowgeometry --shell 2>/dev/null || true; pgrep -af 'chrome.*127.0.0.1:8788|chrome.*user-data-dir=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual/chrome-profile' | head -n 40 || true
